info.name: TeachingPlan - scoreRule 回写与回传 (20260721)
info.description:
变更摘要（前端必看）

【1】考核评价 POST/PUT /assessment 可顺带回写主表计分规则
  请求体增加可选字段 scoreRule (String)
  - 有值(含空串) → 回写 t_csys_teaching_plan.score_rule
  - 不传 / null → 不改主表计分规则
  - planId 必填(新增时必带；修改时建议带，否则无法定位主表)
  注意: scoreRule 不是 assessment 表字段，与 scoreSystem(成绩评定制) 不同

【2】回传 scoreRule
  GET /teachingPlan/list           → TeachingPlanListVo.scoreRule
  GET /teachingPlan/detail         → TeachingPlanDetailVo.scoreRule
  GET /teachingPlan/assessment/list → 每条 assessment.scoreRule 均填充同一主表值(便于考核页回显)

【3】仍可通过 POST /teachingPlan/save  body.plan.scoreRule 单独保存

服务: {{baseUrl}}/csys , port 9219

item.name: 1. 新增考核项目并回写计分规则 POST /assessment

body.raw:
{
  "planId": {{planId}},
  "itemId": null,
  "assessmentCategory": 2,
  "assessmentItem": "平时作业",
  "method": "批改",
  "mechanism": "任课教员",
  "scoreSystem": "百分制",
  "outcomeType": 0,
  "assessedContent": "基础知识掌握",
  "weight": 20,
  "standard": "按时提交、正确率≥60% 合格",
  "sort": 1,
  "scoreRule": "总评成绩 = 形成性考核×40% + 终结性考核×60%。形成性含平时作业、实验报告；终结性为期末闭卷考试。"
}

request.description:
POST /teachingPlan/assessment

【本次变更】body 可带 scoreRule：
- 先 insert t_csys_teaching_plan_assessment 行
- 若 scoreRule != null 且 planId != null，再 UPDATE t_csys_teaching_plan SET score_rule=?
- scoreRule 不落 assessment 表

返回 DataSet<Long> 新 assessment id

item.name: 2. 修改考核项目并回写计分规则 PUT /assessment

body.raw:
{
  "id": {{id}},
  "planId": {{planId}},
  "assessmentCategory": 2,
  "assessmentItem": "平时作业",
  "weight": 25,
  "standard": "更新评价标准",
  "sort": 1,
  "scoreRule": "总评成绩 = 形成性×50% + 终结性×50%。"
}

request.description:
PUT /teachingPlan/assessment

【本次变更】body.scoreRule 有值时回写主表。
建议始终带 planId，否则无法定位主表。
不传 scoreRule 或传 null = 只改考核行，不动主表计分规则。

item.name: 3. 考核项目列表(含scoreRule回显) GET /assessment/list

request.description:
【本次变更】列表每条 assessment 额外带 scoreRule，值来自主表 t_csys_teaching_plan.score_rule（各行相同）。
前端考核页可直接取 data[0].scoreRule 回显计分规则文本框。
